hints.title: Digit Value Minimization
hints.text: Smaller leading digits result in a smaller overall sum for both numbers.

hints.title: Ascending Digit Allocation
hints.text: Sort all digits of the number in non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Alternating Distribution
hints.text: Distribute digits alternately between the two numbers to minimize the higher-order place values.

hints.title: Greedy Digit Splitting Implementation

variables: d: number of digits in num
complexity.notes: Sorting digits takes O(d log d) time where d <= 10.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Partitioning digits into all subset combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that alternating sorted digits minimizes positional weights.
